name: HP USB Keyboard
notes: 63-byte report descriptor of the keyboard interface (interface 0) of a real HP USB Keyboard, from the usb-hid-device-report-corpus dump of the device: https://github.com/steve-chamberlin/usb-hid-device-report-corpus/blob/37179eb6d8c61847c27a6def827a9dce39bf608d/keyboards/03F0-354A HP USB keyboard AZERTY 803181-051.txt#L68-L71. The source gives the device's name, not its own USB strings, so productString is that name. Other interfaces of the real device are not part of this profile.
